title: Fleet Planning Analyst
text:
Fleet Planning Analyst - Example Freight Pvt Ltd, Chennai (On site)

About the role
Example Freight Pvt Ltd moves goods for manufacturers across South India. You will join the planning team and work with warehouse and transport leads every day.

What you will do
- Write SQL queries on shipment and inventory tables
- Keep the weekly stock plan in Excel
- Clean messy order data before each planning cycle (data cleaning)
- Use statistics to explain late deliveries
- Build fleet scheduling sheets with the planning lead
- Publish dashboards in Power BI for the operations head

What we need
- 0 to 2 years of experience in an analyst role
- Strong SQL and Excel
- Working knowledge of SAP WM

Good to have
- Python for automating reports
- Tableau

Notice period: immediate joiners preferred.
